notes.title: Halloween Update + Song-Contest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! We're excited to announce to you the ODDADA Halloween Update  🎃

Not only does this upgrade include a small content update with: 

a new spooky scale
2 new sound pieces
3 new stickers


But also:

We are launching a Halloween Song Contest on our Discord server starting today, on the 27th of October, until the 3rd of November!

There's 3 prizes to be won - in the form of Steam gift cards - in the following 3 categories:

🎃 = most spooky (10€)
🌈 = most creative (10€)
🎹 = banger award (10€)

So make sure to join our DISCORD and show us your spoooookiest creations 👻

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for ODDADA!

This version includes several stability improvements and preparations for the things to come. 🙂

Thank you for your continued support! 

Have questions or want to report a bug? Feel free to join our Discord community! 
We're always here to help and love hearing back from you.

Controls

Made Knobs interactable via both horizontal and vertical mouse movements.
Made Knobs interactable via controller.

Menus & UI

Resolved a visual glitch where the train's roof would jump when clicked. 
Fixed possible color bleeding during transitions between scenes.
Updated the icon for the Desktop Shortcut for Windows.
Updated Splash Screen.

Localization

Fixed a text break issue in the Train Screen for French. 

Save System

Optimized the performance and resilience for saving cassettes.
Prepared save files and UI for future updates.

Bug Tracking

Enhanced local logging system to make it easier finding bugs in the future.
  
  Important: This logging system is completely offline and local to your device. We do not have access to these logs unless you choose to send them to us. If you encounter issues and wish to share your logs for support, you'll need to manually send them to us.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Levels

Music Machine - Fixed issues where this level could sometimes get out of sync.
Chords - Resolved the bug where towers started to fly, when one clicked them fast enough.
Factory - Updated colliders in the factory level preventing clipping.

Train

Metronome - Fixed an issue where one could get stuck, when recording with the Metronome turned off.

Sound Bricks

Bell Towers - Fixed a crash that occurred when Bell Towers were triggering each other.

Menus & UI

Skippable Splash Screen - The splash screen following the Unity logo can now be skipped, letting you jump into the action faster.
Reset Button - We’ve added a brand-new reset button to the settings, allowing you to quickly wipe your save game.

Achievement Localization  

French and Portuguese (big thanks to our community!)
German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Russian 
(Spanish will soon follow)

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey there! So it already has been over a month since we released the demo during Next Fest.
Currently, we are in the midst of making our game ready for our big release THIS SUMMER.

In the meantime, we thought you’d enjoy a new version of the demo with some of the improvements we made so far. :) 
Without any further ado, here are the changes:

Highlights

Plattenboy Level - Upgrade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862512/59bf3679ea2d7b0391013ea867fdbe0dc4e4849f.gifThe Plattenboy got a whole new additional device to explore and tinker with.

Chord Towers Level - Camera Angle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862512/c7798a23d4a16d2f1fa93f4e352243758858756d.gifIt’s easier now to reach the towers in the back.

Performance Improvements
We were able to boost the FPS by about 3x to 5x on our test system from 2015 (Intel i7 with integrated graphics). So should the game have caused some trouble for your GPU in the past, maybe now is the perfect time to give it another go.

Further Changes and Improvements

Levels

 Plattenboy - Got a completely new device to play around with.
 Chord Towers - It is easier now to reach the towers in the back. 
 Organ - Does record more precisely now when a key was pressed.
 Sound Bricks are harder to lose inside levels now.
 Fixed possible Camera clipping during level transitions.

Train

 Loco - When recording, the window will be red and blinking now.

Cassettes

 Song Exporter - By default, the UI will hide your username in the file path now.
 Song Exporter - The UI got overall simplified by removing unnecessary buttons.
 Song Exporter - When done exporting, the computer shows a checkmark now.
 Cassette Player - The non-interactable playhead now looks less interactable.
 Cassette Editor - The cassette slot now looks more like a slot.
 Cassette Editor - The “?” key got replaced with a “ “ key (space).
 Untitled Cassettes without a title get the title “Untitled” now.
 Titles of Cassettes are perfectly horizontally centered now.
 Fixed a possible bug preventing a cassette to not be saved.

Sounds

 Cassette Box - Got some new latch sounds.

Graphics

 Performance Optimisations
 Anti-aliasing is optional now. You can find a toggle in the Settings.
 MacBooks with a Notch now use the full width of the screen by default.

Menus & UI

 Localisation - Added Russian translation.
 Improved text wrapping for Spanish and Portuguese.

Miscellaneous

 Concert - Fixed a possible bug getting stuck in the Concert.

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
Get ready!

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We will show lots of new footage of ODDADA!

Don’t miss out on updates!
